title: Anticoagulants and Reversal Agents: Key Comparisons
subject: Drug of Choice
preview: Warfarin reduces synthesis of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors; heparins potentiate antithrombin; direct oral agents target factor Xa or thrombin.
quickRevision: Warfarin reduces synthesis of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors; heparins potentiate antithrombin; direct oral agents target factor Xa or thrombin.
Protamine reverses unfractionated heparin activity, while idarucizumab targets dabigatran.
Andexanet alfa may reverse some factor Xa inhibitors where approved and available; local pathways and risk determine use.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: Warfarin reduces synthesis of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors; heparins potentiate antithrombin; direct oral agents target factor Xa or thrombin.
Vitamin K and prothrombin complex concentrate may be used for major warfarin-associated bleeding under appropriate protocols.

points: A routine INR does not reliably quantify the effect of most direct oral anticoagulants.
